clips.speaker: Kyle Roder
clips.title: 凯尔·罗达：美元走强与油价下跌的悖论——伊朗重返全球贸易
title_lines: 伊朗重返全球贸易的悖论

subtitles.en: For commodities potentially, for oil, I think there is one thing that is probably not being spoken about, spoken about enough over the last couple of weeks is obviously there's a lot of reasons why we're seeing this dollar strength.
subtitles.zh: 对于大宗商品，尤其是石油，过去几周有一个被低估的因素：美元走强背后有很多原因。

subtitles.en: A lot of it is to do with interest rate expectations, obviously, the US Fed versus the rest of the world, but I don't think it should be understated how significant it is that the United States is inviting Iran effectively back into global trade, selling its oil into global markets, and to do so it is going to have to do it with the US dollar and the US dollar payment system, which is, you know, a little bit of a reversal of that kind of de-dollarization trade, which was probably still in play from a structural point of view now, but certainly, you know, looking at last year and at the beginning of this year, you know, one of the reasons why we're seeing sort of dollar weakness.
subtitles.zh: 很大程度上与利率预期有关，即美联储与其他央行的差异。但不可忽视的是，美国正邀请伊朗重返全球贸易，用美元销售石油，这逆转了去美元化趋势，而去年和年初美元走弱的部分原因正是去美元化。

subtitles.en: So, you know, on the surface, this kind of dollar strength, you know, is something that is contributing to a weaker oil price, that if it persists, it will obviously add to, you know, a weaker oil price. I guess the irony there is that, you know, the weaker oil price has very much been driven by these expectations of Iranian supply hitting the markets, and it's also something incidentally that is boosted in the dollar again because of that kind of unwind of the de-dollarization trade.
subtitles.zh: 表面上看，美元走强导致油价下跌，如果持续，将进一步压低油价。讽刺的是，油价下跌很大程度上源于伊朗供应增加的预期，而这又因去美元化交易的逆转进一步推升了美元。

title_lines: 科技股回调掩盖周期性机会

subtitles.en: Well, I mean, I think we are looking at the surface of a narrow subset of stocks, which we're under performing, and, you know, really could be performing simply just because of, you know, some rebalancing going into the end of the quarter, you know, some concerns about where we're going, where we're going with interest rates settings across the globe, and therefore, you know, where valuations are at.
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们看到的只是少数表现不佳的股票，这可能是季度末再平衡以及全球利率走向和估值担忧所致。

subtitles.en: But if you look at the sort of breadth of the market, really things are holding up, okay, there's actually a little bit of rotation going on in the United States, and some other markets across the world too, like cyclicalities performing fairly strongly. You can look at Japan, for example, as a bit of evidence for that.
subtitles.zh: 但看市场广度，其实表现不错，美国和一些其他市场正在发生轮动，周期性板块表现强劲，日本就是例子。

subtitles.en: And so, although there is this volatility in pockets of the market, generally speaking, you know, we've got oil prices coming down, that geopolitical risk premium diminishing. Yes, this might interest rate uncertainty, and that's going to continue on probably lead to our breaks of volatility going forward as well.
subtitles.zh: 尽管市场局部存在波动，但总体来看，油价下跌，地缘政治风险溢价降低。利率不确定性可能继续导致波动，但市场并非恐慌。
zh_highlights: 地缘政治风险溢价降低

subtitles.en: But this is in a market that's sort of panicking or dealing with more uncertainty, if anything, you know, the markets are buying into less uncertainties. So, I think that's, you know, the story here is that it's kind of the inverse of where we were, you know, last year and the start of this year, whereas, you know, more or less looking at a market really dominated by tech and our performing by tech and then forgetting that, you know, there really wasn't that much breadth underneath the market and fundamentals in the economy were pretty weak.
subtitles.zh: 市场并非在恐慌或应对更多不确定性，反而是在消化更少的不确定性。这与去年和年初的情况相反，当时市场由科技股主导，但缺乏广度，经济基本面疲弱。

subtitles.en: Now it's the reverse, you know, we're just sort of getting caught up in the negative headlines in tech rather than looking at those sort of other broader opportunities in the market. Might some of these other opportunities also include China? I mean, the way valuations are, does it, in any way, look attractive or do we sort of set it out until we hit the bottom?
subtitles.zh: 现在情况反转了，我们只关注科技股的负面头条，而忽略了市场中更广泛的机会。这些机会是否也包括中国？从估值看，中国资产是否有吸引力，还是我们应该等待触底？

subtitles.en: I think we need a catalyst for narrative. I mean, if you really look at what has driven Chinese equities and Hong Kong equities incidentally as well over the last year or so is that we need to see evidence from some of those companies that can deliver growth opportunities, which is effectively the artificial intelligence names in China, whether they, you know, be Tencent or Alibaba, we have another deep seek moment, where it sparks some kind of rotation out of, you know, those kind of leading arguably richly valid, but not that richly valid tech names in the United States.
subtitles.zh: 我们需要叙事催化剂。过去一年驱动中国和香港市场的，是那些能提供增长机会的公司，主要是中国的AI企业，比如腾讯、阿里巴巴。我们需要另一个“DeepSeek时刻”，引发资金从美国估值过高的科技股轮动出来。

subtitles.en: And the drag is some of that capital back into China and Hong Kong. That's really what's missing at the moment, but if you do look at valuations and where sentiment is at, sentiment's pretty positive still in US tech names. The Chinese tech and Asia tech, well not Asia tech, Chinese tech in particular has under performed recently. There is, I think, a very strong argument to suggest that two cheap, two oversold and this might be a good time to kind of rotate a little bit out of the winners into those other companies in China, which will benefit effectively from the same team.
subtitles.zh: 资金回流中国和香港市场正是目前所缺失的。但看估值和情绪，美国科技股情绪仍然积极，而中国科技股近期表现落后。我认为有充分理由认为它们过于便宜、超卖，现在可能是从赢家轮动到中国公司的好时机，它们将从同一趋势中受益。

subtitles.en: Doesn't worry you that we're seeing even on the industrial front, they don't seem to be benefiting from perhaps the AI exports boom with this dip in industrial profit. It shows that there's the decoupling going on that we've seen for quite some time here, that we have a ecosystem, an AI ecosystem led by the United States and that filters through to South Korea and some other parts of Asia. And then the other part of the, you know, sort of multipolar block that is building, which is obviously the Chinese AI, Chinese AI ecosystem, which is becoming decoupling from the supply chains and isn't directly benefiting from the flow and effects from a huge investment boom in the United States.
subtitles.zh: 工业利润下滑表明，中国并未从AI出口繁荣中受益。这显示了我们长期以来看到的脱钩：美国主导的AI生态系统惠及韩国等亚洲地区，而中国AI生态系统正在与供应链脱钩，并未直接受益于美国的大规模投入。

subtitles.en: And that kind of, again, AI valuation inflation, I suppose you could say, or increasing multiples that are happening in assets in the United States. So the fact that yes, the industrial activity is where it shows that, you know, China is perhaps behind the curve in some respects when it comes to that part of the AI trade, but also it can't be disentangled to from what is still a very, very anemic Chinese growth story, a structural story in China as well that's being held down, you know, very much by this kind of balance sheet normalization across the private sector.
subtitles.zh: 这再次体现了美国资产的AI估值膨胀。工业活动显示中国在AI交易方面可能落后，但这与中国疲弱的增长故事和结构性因素密不可分，后者受到私人部门资产负债表正常化的压制。
